description: Port pi-mono's DynamicBorder component: a full-width horizontal rule using '─' (U+2500) repeated to terminal width, styled with the theme's borderMuted color. Implements the Component behaviour with render/2 (returns single line) and handle_key/2 (noop passthrough). Used as visual separator above chat area and between chat and input. pi-mono places these in headerContainer (below banner) and between chatContainer and editorContainer.
title: DynamicBorder separator component
